meta.title: The approval card shows Approve/Reject only to the person whose action is pending
gaps: Open the proposal separately as the requester and step-2 approver to assert the buttons are absent for those roles
Verify that clicking Approve with an empty remark sends no network request because no request endpoint is specified
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the proposal separately as the requester and step-2 approver to assert the buttons are absent for those roles; Verify that clicking Approve with an empty remark sends no network request because no request endpoint is specified

steps.note: Open the already prepared award proposal, as required for this case.
Assert the current session, intended to represent the pending approver, sees Approve.
Assert the pending approver also sees Reject.
Attempt approval with the remark field empty.
Assert the empty remark is rejected inline at the remarks field.
